########################################################################
# Include python install macros
########################################################################
include(GrPython)
if(NOT PYTHONINTERP_FOUND)
    return()
endif()

add_subdirectory(bindings)

########################################################################
# Install python sources
########################################################################
gr_python_install(FILES __init__.py energy_detector_cf.py ofdm_isac.py ofdm_isac_tx_c.py
                  moving_target_channel_cc.py ofdm_sensing_rx_ccf.py DESTINATION ${GR_PYTHON_DIR}/gnuradio/isac)

########################################################################
# Handle the unit tests
########################################################################
include(GrTest)

set(GR_TEST_TARGET_DEPS gnuradio-isac)

# Create a package directory that tests can import. It includes everything
# from `python/`.
add_custom_target(
    copy_module_for_tests ALL
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
            ${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/test_modules/gnuradio/isac/)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_energy_detector_cf ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_energy_detector_cf.py)
GR_ADD_TEST(qa_ofdm_isac ${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_ofdm_isac.py)
